item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 04/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China today. Meanwhile, a cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures will fall progressively and there will be a few rain patches over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be rather cool towards the weekend. It will be brighter over the weekend, but still cool in the morning and at night. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly early next week.

Date/Month: 04/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, northeast force 4 at night.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Coastal fog at first. Bright periods during the day. Isolated thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
